caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, one large and one small. The larger figure has dark hair and a beard, and is mostly unclothed except for a green skirt-like garment with a red border and a red diagonal sash with white spots. This figure stands barefoot and holds a tall staff with green leaves in the left hand. The right arm supports the smaller figure, who is clothed in a red garment with a yellow collar. The smaller figure holds a green globe-like object topped with a small cross in the left hand, and the right hand is raised with two fingers pointing up. The background is brownish-yellow and decorated with small green and red bush-like figures at the bottom. The scene is bordered by a red and black inner frame. On the right edge of the drawing, there is a green curtain with red trim, gathered with a large red tie. At the top, a black swag hangs down as part of the border design. The entire composition is surrounded by a broad brown outer border.
title: Retablo - San Christopher
